## Figure 6B-C : volcano plot

```{r}
fdr_thresh <- 0.05
fc_thresh  <- 0.5

pub_volcano_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title       = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle    = element_blank(),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title     = element_blank(),
    legend.text      = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.key.size  = unit(0.8, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin      = margin(6, 10, 6, 6),
    legend.position  = "right"
  )

make_volcano <- function(df, comparison_label,
                         fdr_thresh = 0.05, fc_thresh = 0.5, fc_cap = 8) {

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_fdr = -log10(FDR),
      group = case_when(
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC >=  fc_thresh ~ "Up",
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC <= -fc_thresh ~ "Down",
        TRUE                                   ~ "ns"
      ),
      group = factor(group, levels = c("Up", "Down", "ns")),
      logFC_plot = pmax(pmin(logFC, fc_cap), -fc_cap)
    )

  n_up   <- sum(df$group == "Up",   na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df$group == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)

  cols <- c("Up" = "#D6604D", "Down" = "#4393C3", "ns" = "grey75")

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_plot, y = neg_log10_fdr, color = group)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(df, group == "ns"),
               size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3, shape = 16) +
    geom_point(data = filter(df, group != "ns"),
               size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_thresh, fc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cols,
      breaks = c("Up", "Down", "ns"),
      labels = c(paste0("Up (n = ", n_up, ")"),
                 paste0("Down (n = ", n_down, ")"),
                 "Not significant")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
    labs(
      x = expression("Log"[2]*" fold change"),
      y = expression("-log"[10]*"(FDR)")
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle    = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey20"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 15),

      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.6, "lines"),

      legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.spacing.x   = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.margin      = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),

      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.margin      = margin(6, 4, 6, 6),
      legend.position  = "right"
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1)))


  list(plot = p, n_up = n_up, n_down = n_down)
}
```

```{r fig.width=3.5, fig.height=2.5}

})
```

## Figure 6C: Number of dysregulated pahtways

```{r}
fdr_thresh_path <- 0.05

pathway_counts <- gsea_res_dfr %>%
  filter(MsigDb %in% c("M5:GO:BP", "MH", "M2:CP:REACTOME")) %>%
  filter(FDR < fdr_thresh_path) %>%
  mutate(
    collection = dplyr::recode(MsigDb,
                               "M5:GO:BP"       = "GO:BP",
                               "MH"             = "Hallmark",
                               "M2:CP:REACTOME" = "Reactome"),
    collection = factor(collection, levels = c("GO:BP", "Hallmark", "Reactome")),
    direction  = ifelse(log2FC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
    direction  = factor(direction, levels = c("Down", "Up")),
    contrast_label = case_when(
      grepl("Vehicle", Contrast) ~ "VEH",
      grepl("AZA",     Contrast) ~ "AZA+Tc",
      TRUE                       ~ Contrast
    ),
    contrast_label = factor(contrast_label, levels = c("VEH", "AZA+Tc"))
  ) %>%
  count(collection, contrast_label, direction, name = "n_pathways")

bar_totals <- pathway_counts %>%
  group_by(collection, contrast_label) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(n_pathways), .groups = "drop")

dir_cols <- c("Up" = "#D6604D", "Down" = "#4393C3")

pub_bar_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle     = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20"),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey20"),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = margin(6, 10, 6, 6),
    legend.position    = "top"
  )

p_pathways <- ggplot(pathway_counts,
                     aes(x = contrast_label, y = n_pathways, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text(
    data = bar_totals,
    aes(x = contrast_label, y = total, label = total, fill = NULL),
    vjust = -0.4, size = 4, fontface = "bold", color = "grey20"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ collection, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = dir_cols, breaks = c("Up", "Down")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "N. dysregulated pathways") +
  pub_bar_theme
```

## Figure 6 D

```{r}
fdr_thresh_path <- 0.05
n_top            <- 5

clean_pathway_label <- function(x, max_width = 40) {
  x %>%
    gsub("^HALLMARK_|^GOBP_|^GOCC_|^GOMF_|^KEGG_|^REACTOME_|^WP_", "", .) %>%
    gsub("_", " ", .) %>%
    stringr::str_to_upper() %>%
    stringr::str_wrap(width = max_width)
}

pub_gsea_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle      = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 15, face = "plain"),
    axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.key.size    = unit(1.1, "lines"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 20, 10, 10)
  )

make_hallmark_lollipop <- function(contrast_name, gsea_res_dfr,
                                   fdr_thresh = 0.05, n_top = 5) {

  df <- gsea_res_dfr %>%
    filter(MsigDb == "MH", Contrast == contrast_name, FDR < fdr_thresh)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

  top_up   <- df %>% filter(log2FC > 0) %>% arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = n_top)
  top_down <- df %>% filter(log2FC < 0) %>% arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = n_top)

  top_df <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_fdr = -log10(FDR),
      stem_color    = ifelse(log2FC < 0, "#4393C3", "#D6604D"),
      label         = clean_pathway_label(Pathway)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(log2FC)) %>%
    mutate(label = factor(label, levels = rev(unique(label))))

  if (nrow(top_df) == 0) return(NULL)

  x_abs    <- max(abs(top_df$log2FC), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2
  x_lim    <- c(-x_abs, x_abs)
  x_breaks <- round(c(-x_abs, 0, x_abs), 2)
  fdr_max  <- ceiling(max(top_df$neg_log10_fdr, na.rm = TRUE))

  p <- ggplot(top_df, aes(x = log2FC, y = label)) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(xend = 0, yend = label, color = stem_color),
      linewidth = 1.1
    ) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_color() +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = neg_log10_fdr, size = FractionOverlap),
      shape = 16, alpha = 0.92
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.7,
               linetype = "dotted", color = "grey30") +
    scale_color_gradientn(
      colours = viridis::inferno(5, alpha = 1, end = 0.9),
      name    = expression(bold(-log[10](FDR))),
      limits  = c(0, fdr_max),
      breaks  = pretty(c(0, fdr_max), n = 4)
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      range  = c(4, 12),
      name   = "% genes in\npathway",
      labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
      breaks = pretty(top_df$FractionOverlap, n = 3)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = x_lim, breaks = x_breaks) +
    labs(x = "log2FC") +
    pub_gsea_theme +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = 0.9,
                             barheight = 6, order = 1),
      size  = guide_legend(title.position = "top", order = 2,
                           override.aes = list(color = "grey50"))
    )

  list(plot = p, n_up = nrow(top_up), n_down = nrow(top_down))
}
```

## Extra: barcode plots of the top pathways

```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=4.8}
library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)

get_stat <- function(contrast) {
  if (exists("fits") && !is.null(fits[[contrast]])) {
    stat <- fits[[contrast]]$table$logFC
    names(stat) <- fits[[contrast]]$genes$GENEID
  } else {
    stat <- res[[contrast]]$logFC
    names(stat) <- res[[contrast]]$GENEID
  }
  stat
}

get_ranked <- function(contrast) {
  stat <- get_stat(contrast)
  stat <- stat[!is.na(stat) & !duplicated(names(stat))]
  sort(stat, decreasing = TRUE)
}

select_hallmark_paths <- function(contrast_name, gsea_res_dfr,
                                  fdr_thresh = 0.05, n_top = 5) {
  df <- gsea_res_dfr %>%
    filter(MsigDb == "MH", Contrast == contrast_name, FDR < fdr_thresh)

  bind_rows(
    df %>% filter(log2FC > 0) %>% arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = n_top),
    df %>% filter(log2FC < 0) %>% arrange(FDR) %>% slice_head(n = n_top)
  )
}

make_gseaplot <- function(ranked, pw, pw_ensembl, main_title,
                          line_col = "green", base_size = 14) {

  pw_genes <- intersect(pw_ensembl, names(ranked))
  if (length(pw_genes) < 5) return(NULL)

  t2g <- data.frame(term = pw, gene = pw_genes)

  gs <- suppressWarnings(
    clusterProfiler::GSEA(
      geneList      = ranked,
      TERM2GENE     = t2g,
      minGSSize     = 5,
      maxGSSize     = 5000,
      pvalueCutoff  = 1,
      eps           = 0,
      seed          = TRUE,
      verbose       = FALSE
    )
  )
  if (nrow(gs@result) == 0) return(NULL)

  enrichplot::gseaplot2(
    gs, geneSetID = 1,
    title      = main_title,
    color      = line_col,
    base_size  = base_size,
    rel_heights = c(1.5, 0.5, 0.7),
    subplots   = 1:3,
    pvalue_table = FALSE
  )
}

for (contrast in names(res)) {

  sig_paths <- select_hallmark_paths(contrast, gsea_res_dfr,
                                     fdr_thresh = fdr_thresh_path, n_top = n_top)
  if (nrow(sig_paths) == 0) next

  ranked     <- get_ranked(contrast)
  cont_print <- gsub("__", " ", contrast)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig_paths))) {

    pw  <- sig_paths$Pathway[i]
    fc  <- round(sig_paths$log2FC[i], 2)
    fdr <- signif(sig_paths$FDR[i], 2)

    pw_ensembl <- unlist(gene_sets$ensembl[gene_sets$geneset_name == pw])

    main_title <- paste0(pw, "\n", "log2FC: ", fc, " | FDR: ", fdr)

    p <- make_gseaplot(ranked, pw, pw_ensembl, main_title)
    if (is.null(p)) next

    print(p)
    dir.create(file.path(params$fig_dir, "GSEAplot"),showWarnings = FALSE)
    file_name <- paste0("GSEAplot_", pw, "_", contrast, ".pdf")
    ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, "GSEAplot", file_name), p,
           width = 6, height = 4.8)

  }
}
```

## Figure 6E: HLA (equivalent) genes in volcano plots

```{r}
library(ggrepel)

mhcii_genes <- c("H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-Ea", "H2-Eb1",
                 "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-DMb2", "H2-Oa", "H2-Ob")

make_volcano_mhcii <- function(df, comparison_label, highlight = mhcii_genes,
                               fdr_thresh = 0.05, fc_thresh = 0.5, fc_cap = 8) {

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_fdr = -log10(FDR),
      group = case_when(
        Symbol %in% highlight                  ~ "MHC-II",
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC >=  fc_thresh ~ "Up",
        FDR < fdr_thresh & logFC <= -fc_thresh ~ "Down",
        TRUE                                   ~ "ns"
      ),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("Up", "Down", "MHC-II", "ns")),
      logFC_plot = pmax(pmin(logFC, fc_cap), -fc_cap)
    )

  n_up   <- sum(df$group == "Up",   na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df$group == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)
  lab_df <- filter(df, group == "MHC-II")
  n_mhc  <- nrow(lab_df)

  cols <- c("Up" = "#D6604D", "Down" = "#4393C3",
            "MHC-II" = "#7B3294", "ns" = "grey75")

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_plot, y = neg_log10_fdr, color = group)) +
    geom_point(data = filter(df, group == "ns"),
               size = 0.8, alpha = 0.3, shape = 16) +
    geom_point(data = filter(df, group %in% c("Up", "Down")),
               size = 1.4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
    geom_point(data = lab_df, size = 2.6, alpha = 1, shape = 16) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_thresh, fc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = lab_df, aes(label = Symbol),
      color = "#7B3294", fill = "white", fontface = "bold",
      size = 4, label.size = 0.3, box.padding = 0.6, point.padding = 0.3,
      segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.3,
      max.overlaps = Inf, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 42,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cols,
      breaks = c("MHC-II", "Up", "Down", "ns"),
      labels = c("MHC-II genes",
                 paste0("Up (n = ", n_up, ")"),
                 paste0("Down (n = ", n_down, ")"),
                 "Not significant")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = expression("Log"[2]*" fold change"),
         y = expression("-log"[10]*"(FDR)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle    = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 13, color = "grey20"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 12),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(6, 10, 6, 6),
      legend.box.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
      legend.position  = "right"
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1)))


  list(plot = p)
}
```

## Figure 6I: IF/inflamma TFs

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2)

tf_family_plot <- function(acts,
                           families = c(Stat  = "^Stat",
                                        Irf   = "^Irf",
                                        Nfkb  = "^Nfkb",
                                        Atf4  = "^Atf4$"),
                           gate_contrasts = c("VEH_Tcells", "AZA_Tcells"),
                           sig_cut = 0.05,
                           title = NULL,
                           subtitle = NULL
                             ) {

  ## --- assign each TF to a family (NA = no match) --------------------------
  fam_of <- function(x) {
    hit <- vapply(families, \(p) grepl(p, x), logical(1))
    if (any(hit)) names(families)[which(hit)[1]] else NA_character_
  }

  acts_fam <- acts |>
    mutate(family = vapply(source, fam_of, character(1))) |>
    filter(!is.na(family))

  ## --- gate: significant in >=1 of the T-cell arms -------------------------
  keep <- acts_fam |>
    filter(contrast %in% gate_contrasts, padj < sig_cut) |>
    distinct(source) |>
    pull(source)

  acts_fam <- acts_fam |>
    filter(source %in% keep) |>
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = names(families)))

  if (nrow(acts_fam) == 0) {
    message("No TFs from these families are significant in the gate contrasts.")
    return(list(table = acts[0, ], plot = NULL))
  }

  ## --- row order: family, then score in the combined arm -------------------
  ord <- acts_fam |>
    filter(contrast == "AZA_Tcells") |>
    arrange(family, score) |>
    pull(source)

  acts_fam$source <- gsub("_.*", "", acts_fam$source)

  ord <- c(ord, setdiff(unique(acts_fam$source), ord))

  acts_fam <- acts_fam |> mutate(source = factor(source, levels = ord))

  ## --- table ---------------------------------------------------------------
  tbl <- acts_fam |>
    arrange(family, desc(source), contrast) |>
    dplyr::select(family, source, DESCRIPTION, contrast, score, dir,
                  p_value, padj, rank_padj, sig)

  ## --- plot ----------------------------------------------------------------
  p <- ggplot(acts_fam, aes(contrast, source)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(padj), 6), fill = score, colour = sig),
               shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B4CC0", mid = "white", high = "#B40426",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "TF enrichment\nscore") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey80"),
                        name = "FDR < 0.05", labels = c("no", "yes")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 7), name ="FDR",
                          breaks = c(1.3, 3, 6), labels = c("0.05", "0.001", "\u22641e-6")) +
    facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "white"))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(axis.text.x     = element_text(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
          strip.placement  = "outside")

  list(table = tbl, plot = p)
}
```

## 6J : Volcano plot of gene statistics - Stat1.

```{r}
tf_name      <- "Stat1_chip"
stat1_targets <- net %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(source == tf_name) %>%
  pull(target) %>%
  unique()

make_volcano_tf <- function(df, comparison_label, targets, tf_name,
                            fdr_thresh = 0.05, fc_thresh = 0.5, fc_cap = 8) {

  df <- as.data.frame(df) %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log10_fdr = -log10(FDR),
      is_sig    = FDR < fdr_thresh & abs(logFC) >= fc_thresh,
      is_target = Symbol %in% targets,
      group = case_when(
        is_target & is_sig ~ "Target_sig",
        is_target          ~ "Target_ns",
        is_sig             ~ "Other_sig",
        TRUE               ~ "ns"
      ),
      group      = factor(group, levels = c("ns", "Other_sig", "Target_ns", "Target_sig")),
      logFC_plot = pmax(pmin(logFC, fc_cap), -fc_cap)
    )

  n_t_sig <- sum(df$group == "Target_sig")
  n_t_ns  <- sum(df$group == "Target_ns")
  n_t_all <- n_t_sig + n_t_ns

  cols   <- c("ns" = "grey75", "Other_sig" = "grey45",
              "Target_ns" = "#F4B6AC",
              "Target_sig" = "#D6604D")
  sizes  <- c("ns" = 0.8, "Other_sig" = 1.2, "Target_ns" = 2.5, "Target_sig" = 3.0)
  alphas <- c("ns" = 0.3, "Other_sig" = 0.5, "Target_ns" = 0.9, "Target_sig" = 0.95)

  df <- df %>% arrange(group)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC_plot, y = neg_log10_fdr,
                      color = group, size = group, alpha = group)) +
    geom_point(shape = 16) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_thresh, fc_thresh),
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, color = "grey45") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = cols,
      breaks = c("Target_sig", "Target_ns"),
      labels = c(paste0(tf_name, " targets, significant (n = ", n_t_sig, ")"),
                 paste0(tf_name, " targets, not significant (n = ", n_t_ns, ")"))
    ) +
    scale_size_manual(values = sizes, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = alphas, guide = "none") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.06))) +
    labs(x = expression("Log"[2]*" fold change (KO vs CTRL)"),
         y = expression("-log"[10]*"(FDR)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_blank(),
      plot.subtitle    = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey20"),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
      legend.title     = element_blank(),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.key.size  = unit(0.8, "lines"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin      = margin(6, 10, 6, 6),
      legend.position  = "right"
    ) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.direction = "vertical") +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1)))


  list(plot = p, n_targets = n_t_all)
}
```

## Heatmap of immune activation / inflammation genes

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

genes_hm <- c("Ccl2", "Ccl4", "Ccl7", "Ccl12", "Cybb",
              "Cd40", "Cd80", "Cd86", "S100a8", "S100a9")

gene_map <- as.data.frame(dge$genes) %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% genes_hm) %>%
  select(GENEID, Symbol)

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0)
  message("Not found in data (dropped): ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))

gene_map <- gene_map[match(intersect(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol), gene_map$Symbol), ]

grp_levels <- c("NTC_Vehicle", "KO_Vehicle", "NTC_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells")
grp_labels <- c("CTRL VEH", "KO VEH", "CTRL AZA+T cells", "KO AZA+T cells")

samp <- as.data.frame(dge$samples)
samp$group_label <- factor(
  as.character(samp$SampleGroup),
  levels = grp_levels, labels = grp_labels
)

samp_ord <- samp[order(samp$group_label), ]
sample_ids <- rownames(samp_ord)

mat <- log2cpm[gene_map$GENEID, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- gene_map$Symbol

mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))

grp_cols <- c("CTRL VEH" = "#9ECAE1", "KO VEH" = "#3182BD",
              "CTRL AZA+T cells"     = "#FCBBA1", "KO AZA+T cells" = "#CB181D")

z_lim   <- max(abs(mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-z_lim, 0, z_lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = samp_ord$group_label,
  col   = list(Group = grp_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group",
                 title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  )
)

show_ns <- TRUE

get_stat <- function(contrast) {
  as.data.frame(res[[contrast]]) %>%
    filter(Symbol %in% rownames(mat_z)) %>%
    slice(match(rownames(mat_z), Symbol)) %>%
    select(Symbol, logFC, FDR)
}
st_veh <- get_stat("KO__vs__NTC_Vehicle")
st_aza <- get_stat("KO__vs__NTC_AZA_Tcells")

sig_lab <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,   "*", if (show_ns) "ns" else ""))))
}

m            <- max(abs(c(st_veh$logFC, st_aza$logFC)), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_stat <- colorRamp2(c(-m, 0, m), c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D"))

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  `VEH` = anno_simple(
    st_veh$logFC, col = col_fun_stat,
    pch = sig_lab(st_veh$FDR),
    pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    na_col = "grey90", width = unit(6, "mm")
  ),
  `AZA+\nT cells` = anno_simple(
    st_aza$logFC, col = col_fun_stat,
    pch = sig_lab(st_aza$FDR),
    pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    na_col = "grey90", width = unit(6, "mm")
  ),

  spacer = anno_empty(width = unit(10, "mm"), border = FALSE),

  annotation_name_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  annotation_name_side   = "top",
  annotation_name_rot    = 60,
  annotation_name_offset = unit(2, "mm"),
  show_annotation_name   = c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE),
  gap                    = unit(2, "mm")
)

stat_legend <- Legend(
  col_fun = col_fun_stat,
  title   = "log2FC\n(KO vs CTRL)",
  direction = "vertical",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name                = "Row z-score\n(log2CPM)",
  col                 = col_fun,
  top_annotation      = top_anno,
  right_annotation    = row_anno,
  cluster_rows        = FALSE,
  cluster_columns     = FALSE,
  column_split        = samp_ord$group_label,
  column_title        = NULL,
  show_column_names   = FALSE,
  row_names_side      = "left",
  row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "italic"),
  column_gap          = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  border              = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
)
```

```{r fig.width=7.1, fig.height=3.3}
     heatmap_legend_side    = "right",

     ht_gap  = unit(8, "mm"))

file_hm <- "heatmap_immune_genes.pdf"
pdf(file.path(params$fig_dir, file_hm), width = 7.1, height = 3.3)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE,

dev.off()
```

## Heatmap `GOBP_ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_AND_PRESENTATION_OF_EXOGENOUS_PEPTIDE_ANTIGEN_VIA_MHC_CLASS_II`

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

pw_name <- "GOBP_ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_AND_PRESENTATION_OF_EXOGENOUS_PEPTIDE_ANTIGEN_VIA_MHC_CLASS_II"

pw_ens <- unlist(gene_sets$ensembl[gene_sets$geneset_name == pw_name])
pw_ens <- intersect(unique(pw_ens), rownames(log2cpm))

message(length(pw_ens), " genes of the gene set found in log2cpm")

gene_map <- as.data.frame(dge$genes) %>%
  filter(GENEID %in% pw_ens) %>%
  select(GENEID, Symbol)

grp_levels <- c("NTC_Vehicle", "KO_Vehicle", "NTC_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells")
grp_labels <- c("CTRL VEH", "KO VEH", "CTRL AZA+T cells", "KO AZA+T cells")

samp <- as.data.frame(dge$samples)
samp$group_label <- factor(as.character(samp$SampleGroup),
                           levels = grp_levels, labels = grp_labels)
samp_ord   <- samp[order(samp$group_label), ]
sample_ids <- rownames(samp_ord)

mat <- log2cpm[gene_map$GENEID, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- gene_map$Symbol
mat <- mat[!duplicated(rownames(mat)), , drop = FALSE]

mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))
```

## Heatmap `GOBP_ANTIGEN_PROCESSING_AND_PRESENTATION_OF_PEPTIDE_OR_POLYSACCHARIDE_ANTIGEN_VIA_MHC_CLASS_II`

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

genes_hm <- c("Ciita", "Cd74", "H2-Aa", "H2-Ab1", "H2-Ea",
              "H2-Eb1", "H2-DMa", "H2-DMb1", "H2-DMb2")

gene_map <- as.data.frame(dge$genes) %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% genes_hm) %>%
  select(GENEID, Symbol)

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0)
  message("Not found in data (dropped): ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))

gene_map <- gene_map[match(intersect(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol), gene_map$Symbol), ]

grp_levels <- c("NTC_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells")
grp_labels <- c("CTRL AZA+T cells", "KO AZA+T cells")

samp <- as.data.frame(dge$samples)
samp <- samp |>
  filter(samp$SampleGroup %in% grp_levels)
samp$group_label <- factor(as.character(samp$SampleGroup),
                           levels = grp_levels, labels = grp_labels)
samp_ord   <- samp[order(samp$group_label), ]
sample_ids <- rownames(samp_ord)

mat <- log2cpm[gene_map$GENEID, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- gene_map$Symbol
mat <- mat[!duplicated(rownames(mat)), , drop = FALSE]

mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))

grp_cols <- c("CTRL AZA+T cells" = "#FCBBA1", "KO AZA+T cells" = "#CB181D")

z_lim   <- max(abs(mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-z_lim, 0, z_lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = samp_ord$group_label,
  col   = list(Group = grp_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group",
                 title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  )
)
show_ns <- TRUE

st_aza <- as.data.frame(res[["KO__vs__NTC_AZA_Tcells"]]) %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% rownames(mat_z)) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(mat_z), Symbol)) %>%
  select(Symbol, logFC, FDR)

sig_lab <- function(p) {
  ifelse(is.na(p), "",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,   "*", if (show_ns) "ns" else ""))))
}

m            <- max(abs(st_aza$logFC), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun_stat <- colorRamp2(c(-m, 0, m), c("#2166AC", "white", "#D6604D"))

row_anno <- rowAnnotation(
  `AZA+Tc` = anno_simple(st_aza$logFC, col = col_fun_stat,
                         pch = sig_lab(st_aza$FDR),
                         pt_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
                         na_col = "grey90", width = unit(5, "mm")),
  annotation_name_gp     = gpar(fontsize = 12),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_name_side   = "top",
  annotation_name_rot    = 90,
  annotation_name_offset = unit(2, "mm")
)

stat_legend <- Legend(
  col_fun = col_fun_stat,
  title   = "log2FC\n(KO vs CTRL)",
  direction = "vertical",
  title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name                = "Row z-score\n(log2CPM)",
  col                 = col_fun,
  top_annotation      = top_anno,
  right_annotation    = row_anno,
  cluster_rows        = TRUE,
  show_row_dend       = FALSE,
  cluster_columns     = FALSE,
  column_split        = samp_ord$group_label,
  column_title        = NULL,
  show_column_names   = FALSE,
  row_names_side      = "left",
  row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "italic"),
  column_gap          = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  border              = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
)
```


## NRF2 related data

```{r}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(ggplot2); library(ggrepel)

comp_r2    <- "KO__vs__NTC_AZA_Tcells"
grp_levels <- c("NTC_Vehicle", "KO_Vehicle", "NTC_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells")
grp_labels <- c("CTRL,Vehicle", "KO,Vehicle", "CTRL,AZA+Tcells", "KO,AZA+Tcells")
grp_cols   <- c("CTRL,Vehicle" = "#9ECAE1", "KO,Vehicle" = "#3182BD",
                "CTRL,AZA+Tcells" = "#FCBBA1", "KO,AZA+Tcells" = "#CB181D")

samp_df <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(dge$samples),
  group  = factor(as.character(dge$samples$SampleGroup),
                  levels = grp_levels, labels = grp_labels)
)

fmt_fdr <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1),
                              sprintf("%.3f", p))
```

```{r}
core_genes   <- c("Nfe2l2", "Keap1")
target_genes <- c("Hmox1", "Nqo1", "Gclc", "Gclm", "Txnrd1", "Slc7a11",
                  "Gsr", "Prdx1", "Sqstm1", "Fth1", "Ftl1", "Slc40a1")

make_expr_plot <- function(genes, ncol = 2) {
  gm <- as.data.frame(dge$genes) %>%
    filter(Symbol %in% genes) %>% distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
  miss <- setdiff(genes, gm$Symbol)
  if (length(miss)) message("Not in data (dropped): ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))

  stats <- as.data.frame(res[[comp_r2]]) %>%
    filter(Symbol %in% gm$Symbol) %>%
    transmute(Symbol,
              gene_lab = sprintf("%s\nlog2FC = %.2f, FDR = %s", Symbol, logFC, fmt_fdr(FDR)))

  long <- log2cpm[gm$GENEID, , drop = FALSE] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("GENEID") %>%
    left_join(select(gm, GENEID, Symbol), by = "GENEID") %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(GENEID, Symbol), names_to = "sample", values_to = "log2cpm") %>%
    left_join(samp_df, by = "sample") %>%
    left_join(stats, by = "Symbol") %>%
    mutate(gene_lab = factor(gene_lab, levels = stats$gene_lab[match(genes, stats$Symbol)] %>% na.omit()))

  ggplot(long, aes(group, log2cpm, fill = group, colour = group)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7, shape = 16) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene_lab, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncol) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = grp_cols) + scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = expression("log"[2]*"CPM")) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 30, hjust = 1, color = "black"),
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
          axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey94", color = NA),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank())
}

p_expr_core    <- make_expr_plot(core_genes, ncol = 2)
p_expr_core

f1 <- "NRF2_expression_core.pdf";    ggsave(file.path(params$fig_dir, f1), p_expr_core,    width = 12, height = 7)
```

## Fig 7F Correlation plot

```{r}
res_run2 <- fread("../../mrnaseq_rmb1_slc6a8_ko_run2/results/tables/diffexp_KO__vs__NTC_AZA_Tcells.txt")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

r3 <- as.data.frame(res[["KO__vs__CTRL_AZA_IFNg"]]) %>%
  select(GENEID, Symbol, logFC_r3 = logFC)

r2 <- as.data.frame(res_run2) %>%
  select(GENEID, logFC_r2 = logFC)

cor_df <- inner_join(r3, r2, by = "GENEID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(logFC_r3), !is.na(logFC_r2))

ct    <- cor.test(cor_df$logFC_r2, cor_df$logFC_r3,
                  method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
rho   <- unname(ct$estimate)
p_val <- ct$p.value

format_pval_safe <- function(p, floor_p = 1e-300) {
  if (is.na(p) || p < floor_p) {
    "  p < 1e-300"
  } else if  (p < 0.001) {
    paste0("  p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1))
  } else {
    sprintf("  p = %.3f", p)
  }
}

ann_label <- paste0("Spearman r = ", sprintf("%.2f", rho), "\n",
                    format_pval_safe(p_val))

ax_lim <- max(abs(c(cor_df$logFC_r2, cor_df$logFC_r3))) * 1.05

p_cor <- ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = logFC_r2, y = logFC_r3)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 3, color = "#2C7BB6", shape = 16) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = ann_label,
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3,
           size = 5.5, color = "black", lineheight = 1.2) +
  labs(
    x = expression("logFC(KO vs CTRL, AZA + T cells)"),
    y = expression("logFC(KO vs CTRL, AZA + IFN-"*gamma*")")
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title         = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle      = element_blank(),
    axis.text          = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title         = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.major   = element_line(color = "grey93", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.margin        = margin(6, 10, 6, 6)
  )
```

```{r fig.width=4, fig.height=3.5}
p_cor
```

## Supp fig ? :Heatmap for Ccl2, Ccl4, Ccl7, Ccl12, Cybb, CD40, CD80, CD86, S100a8, S100a9

```{r}
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)

genes_hm <- c("Ccl2", "Ccl4", "Ccl7", "Ccl12", "Cybb",
              "Cd40", "Cd80", "Cd86", "S100a8", "S100a9")

gene_map <- as.data.frame(dge$genes) %>%
  filter(Symbol %in% genes_hm) %>%
  select(GENEID, Symbol) %>%
  distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)

missing_genes <- setdiff(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol)
if (length(missing_genes) > 0)
  message("Not found in data (dropped): ", paste(missing_genes, collapse = ", "))

gene_map <- gene_map[match(intersect(genes_hm, gene_map$Symbol), gene_map$Symbol), ]

grp_levels <- c("Control_Vehicle", "KO_Vehicle",
                "Control_Tcells",  "KO_Tcells",
                "Control_AZA",     "KO_AZA",
                "Control_AZA_Tcells", "KO_AZA_Tcells")
grp_labels <- c("CTRL Vehicle",   "KO Vehicle",
                "CTRL Tcells",    "KO Tcells",
                "CTRL AZA",       "KO AZA",
                "CTRL AZA+Tcells","KO AZA+Tcells")

samp <- as.data.frame(dge$samples)
samp$group_label <- factor(as.character(samp$SampleGroup),
                           levels = grp_levels, labels = grp_labels)

samp_ord   <- samp[order(samp$group_label), ]
sample_ids <- rownames(samp_ord)

mat <- log2cpm[gene_map$GENEID, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
rownames(mat) <- gene_map$Symbol

mat <- mat[apply(mat, 1, sd) > 0, , drop = FALSE]
mat_z <- t(scale(t(mat)))

grp_cols <- c("CTRL Vehicle"    = "#C6DBEF", "KO Vehicle"    = "#3182BD",
              "CTRL Tcells"     = "#C7E9C0", "KO Tcells"     = "#31A354",
              "CTRL AZA"        = "#FDD0A2", "KO AZA"        = "#E6550D",
              "CTRL AZA+Tcells" = "#FCBBA1", "KO AZA+Tcells" = "#CB181D")

z_lim   <- max(abs(mat_z), na.rm = TRUE)
col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-z_lim, 0, z_lim), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))

top_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = samp_ord$group_label,
  col   = list(Group = grp_cols),
  show_annotation_name = FALSE,
  annotation_legend_param = list(
    Group = list(title = "Group",
                 title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
                 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12))
  )
)

ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_z,
  name                = "Row z-score\n(log2CPM)",
  col                 = col_fun,
  top_annotation      = top_anno,
  cluster_rows        = FALSE,
  cluster_columns     = FALSE,
  column_split        = samp_ord$group_label,
  column_title        = NULL,
  show_column_names   = FALSE,
  row_names_side      = "left",
  row_names_gp        = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "italic"),
  column_gap          = unit(1.5, "mm"),
  border              = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    title_gp  = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold"),
    labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12)
  )
)
```

```{r fig.width=7.5,fig.height=3}
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)

file_hm_r1 <- "heatmap_inflammatory_genes_Run1_8groups.pdf"
pdf(file.path(params$fig_dir, file_hm_r1), width = 7.5, height = 3)
draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE)
dev.off()
```

## Figure  IF/inflamma TFs

```{r}
tf_family_plot <- function(acts,
                           families = c(Stat = "^Stat", Irf = "^Irf",
                                        Nfkb = "^Nfkb", Atf4 = "^Atf4$"),
                           gate_contrasts = c("VEH_Tcells", "AZA_Tcells"),
                           order_contrast = "AZA_Tcells",
                           sig_cut = 0.05) {

  fam_of <- function(x) {
    hit <- vapply(families, \(p) grepl(p, x), logical(1))
    if (any(hit)) names(families)[which(hit)[1]] else NA_character_
  }

  acts_fam <- acts |>
    mutate(family = vapply(source, fam_of, character(1))) |>
    filter(!is.na(family))

  keep <- acts_fam |>
    filter(contrast %in% gate_contrasts, padj < sig_cut) |>
    distinct(source) |> pull(source)

  acts_fam <- acts_fam |>
    filter(source %in% keep) |>
    mutate(family = factor(family, levels = names(families)))

  if (nrow(acts_fam) == 0) {
    message("No TFs from these families are significant in the gate contrasts.")
    return(list(table = acts[0, ], plot = NULL))
  }

  acts_fam$source <- gsub("_.*", "", acts_fam$source)

  ord <- acts_fam |>
    filter(contrast == order_contrast) |>
    arrange(family, score) |>
    pull(source) |> unique()
  ord <- c(ord, setdiff(unique(acts_fam$source), ord))
  acts_fam <- acts_fam |> mutate(source = factor(source, levels = ord))

  tbl <- acts_fam |>
    arrange(family, desc(source), contrast) |>
    dplyr::select(family, source, DESCRIPTION, contrast, score, dir,
                  p_value, padj, rank_padj, sig)

  p <- ggplot(acts_fam, aes(contrast, source)) +
    geom_point(aes(size = pmin(-log10(padj), 6), fill = score, colour = sig),
               shape = 21, stroke = 0.4) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#3B4CC0", mid = "white", high = "#B40426",
                         midpoint = 0, name = "TF enrichment\nscore") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey15", `FALSE` = "grey80"),
                        name = "FDR < 0.05", labels = c("no", "yes")) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 7), name = "FDR",
                          breaks = c(1.3, 3, 6),
                          labels = c("0.05", "0.001", "\u22641e-6")) +
    facet_grid(family ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4, fill = "white"))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
          strip.background    = element_blank(),
          strip.text.y.left   = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold"),
          strip.placement     = "outside")

  list(table = tbl, plot = p)
}

tf_act$contrast <- factor(tf_act$contrast, levels = ctr_levels)
fam <- tf_family_plot(tf_act)

out <- fam$plot +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(ctr_labels, ctr_levels)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 16, angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 17, angle = 0, face = "bold")
  )
```
